page.overview:
What is Illumise?

Illumise has a black and bluish-purple body, with two vertical stripes going down the front. Its arms and legs are black as well, and are connected to the body by purple borders. On its front is what resembles a yellow bow or shawl. It has large, slanted eyes with blue irises, and appears to be smiling, unlike its male counterpart, Volbeat. Surrounding its head is a purple appendage with curls at the end that frame its face. Its antennae are also smaller than Volbeat's, and are yellow in color. Illumise has small wings used for flying with Volbeat and other Illumise. Illumise has a pattern of three oblong yellow spots on its rear.

With their sweet aromas, Illumise guide Volbeat in the night sky to draw various geometric patterns.

Illumise is based on a while also taking inspiration from woman's fashion styles, most notably a flapper style. This is evidenced by the way Illumise's collar and stomach pattern are designed, which resemble the hair and clothing style respectively. This style as well as it being a female-only Pokémon line up with Volbeat, who is a male-only Pokémon and has a more men-inspired style.
